column1: # Codec test vectors: name, raw field, encoded field.
# Both fields use %XX hex escapes for every byte below 0x20, for 0x5C and 0x7F,
# and for %25 itself; nothing else is interpreted, so non-ASCII text appears
# unescaped. Keeping every escape below 0x80 lets a reader build the bytes from
# code points without knowing the file's encoding.
# NUL is outside the store contract, so no vector holds one: no supported line
# editor can produce it and it terminates the C strings gawk builds. Every
# other byte below 0x20 and 0x7F must survive a round trip unchanged.
